_comment: Copy to <install>/daily-content-pipeline/collector/healthcheck/fixtures.json and fill in the operator's OWN targets. Keys starting with _ are ignored. `tool healthcheck fixtures` prints which keys are still missing. Never point a fixture at a production client's account or a third party's group.
fb_own_post_url: https://www.facebook.com/reel/<reel id the test account published>
fb_canary_profile_entity_id: <numeric facebook id of the test account>
fb_canary_profile_name: <display name exactly as Facebook renders it>
fb_canary_profile_email: <email published in the test account's About / contact info>
fb_video_page_url: https://www.facebook.com/<page with at least one video>/videos
ig_canary_post_url: https://www.instagram.com/p/<post the operator may read whose comments are visible; optional>/
fb_search_group_url: https://www.facebook.com/groups/<public group with many posts, read only>
